gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Modern and contemporary at heart, this pairing sets Wallpoet's bold, high-rising lowercase against a quieter partner. Kdam Thmor Pro fills its bowls right out to the line, a sturdy sans-serif for the running text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-krona-one: Krona One reads approachable and loosely spaced, its lowercase standing as tall as cast iron capitals under Wallpoet's commanding, see-through lines. That mix of heft and openness is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-magra: Big-bodied and blunt, Magra gives every lowercase word real mass beneath Wallpoet's bold, high-reaching letters. Both lean heavy, so they hold the page together without fuss.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-major-mono-display: Wallpoet commands with high lowercase and gaps where the paper shows through, while Major Mono Display glows beneath in tube-like neon strokes. The precision of that monospace is what stays with you.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-martian-mono: Wallpoet's smooth, unobstructed curves and see-through gaps make its heading unmistakable, a bold shape with no hairline-to-stem shifts to soften it. Martian Mono then lays out fixed-width, code-like letters with generous spacing, a monospace texture that moves steadily.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-matemasie: Matemasie spreads broad gaps between its glyphs and draws every stroke at one weight, with small entry points into the round letters. Wallpoet handles bold, see-through display work best, while this sans quietly handles the reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-menbere: Menbere reads clean and neutral, its lowercase stacked tall like rolled cord, a sans-serif that keeps the eye moving. Over many lines it settles into a tidy, upright rhythm, a pleasing foil for Wallpoet's heavier voice.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mitr: Wallpoet brings bold, commanding lowercase that rises high and lets the paper show through between letters. But Mitr, with almost no gap between x-height and cap height, would look cramped if the heading were shrunk to its size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-momo-trust-display: Sharp and spaced-out, this pairing sets Wallpoet's bold, see-through letters over Momo Trust Display's drifting, generously tall lowercase. And that sans keeps a long page feeling clean and unhurried, never crowding the line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mukta: Wallpoet is the bold, commanding voice here, with lowercase that rises high and smooth curves that never snag. Yet Mukta, with its tall-bodied small letters, does the quieter job of carrying the sentences with a clean, neutral hand.
